assets.title: Heavy Freighter
assets.change: Give the freighter a visibly STOCKY CARGO hull: shorten the hull horizontally and deepen its broad rounded belly substantially, hull width about 2.4 times hull depth, high blunt rounded bow on RIGHT, squat raised stern on LEFT. Broad almost level deck, bulbous bottom, heavy tan planking in only three large bands; two large cargo hatch covers attached on deck and no rows of gunports. It must read as a burdened cargo vessel with deep hold, not a slender schooner with an extra plank. Keep three deck-rooted square-rigged masts, six simple cream square sails, red pennant, short right bowsprit and three sparse waterline strokes. Compress the spacing and reduce the rig’s height a little to reinforce the squat mass. Every mast connects visibly to the deck; sail yards connect to masts. No floating sails, detached rigging, or modern containers.

assets.title: Ironclad
assets.change: Remove the pointed RAM completely. Rebuild the RIGHT end as an ordinary modestly rounded upright ship bow continuous with the closed armor hull, with no spike, blade, ram, or projecting underwater weapon. Keep the low tan armored hull, large plate seams, few brass rivets, dark underside and reinforced two-window pilothouse on LEFT. The one deck-rooted mast now carries a LARGE functional cream SQUARE SAIL attached directly to its horizontal yard, with one fold mark and simple ropes returning to deck. Mast, yard, sail and deck must connect naturally; sail sits above pilot house and hull without hiding the entire mast root. Red pennant may remain at mast top. No chimney, engine, smoke, steam equipment, or bare ornamental mast. Face RIGHT. Preserve sparse waterline strokes.
